verdict.rationale: Marqeta explicitly documents an Agentic AI / MCP Server offering that names AI agents by name: instant virtual card issuance, spend controls (velocity limits, spending caps, merchant restrictions) and transaction intelligence for agents, backed by the underlying Core API primitives for cards, velocity controls, and merchant authorization controls that provide expiry/amount/merchant scoping. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on third-party validation of an agent actually using a scoped card end-to-end, and no explicit mention of card expiry configuration in the agentic guide itself.
